title: AI Finds A Way
abstract: arXiv:2608.23875v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms frequently learn creative and unexpected solutions, surprising even expert researchers who develop and study them. They often astonish practitioners by discovering unanticipated behavior, exploiting loopholes in reward signals, or spontaneously uncovering previously unknown scientific phenomena. However, accounts of such unconventional behavior across machine learning are seldom formally documented. This work presents 26 curated firsthand anecdotes from various machine learning subfields representing the work of over 100 researchers. These anecdotes showcase the capability of modern AI systems to circumvent human-imposed design limitations and discover unexpected solutions to the tasks we train them on. translated_abstract: 摘要：人工智能（AI）算法经常学习到富有创造性和意想不到的解决方案，甚至让开发和研究它们的专家研究人员感到惊讶。它们常常通过发现未预料到的行为、利用奖励信号中的漏洞，或自发揭示先前未知的科学现象，令从业者惊叹不已。然而，机器学习中这类非常规行为的记录很少被正式记录下来。这项工作呈现了来自多个机器学习子领域的26个经过整理的亲身轶事，代表了超过100位研究者的工作。这些轶事展示了现代AI系统规避人类强加的设计限制，并为我们训练它们的任务发现意外解决方案的能力。此外，这些记录对未来AI系统的安全性尤为重要。它们说明了在不过度削弱模型能力的前提下，将模型与人类价值观对齐这一根本性挑战。
tldr: 本文通过26个来自100多位研究者的亲身轶事，系统记录了AI系统在多个机器学习子领域中规避人类设计限制、发现意外解决方案的能力，并强调这些非常规行为对未来AI安全和对齐研究的重要性。
en_tdlr: This paper documents 26 curated firsthand anecdotes from over 100 researchers across machine learning subfields, showcasing AI systems' ability to circumvent human-imposed design limitations and discover unexpected solutions, highlighting their critical implications for future AI safety and alignment.
